narrative.intro: Fresenius Medical Care Holdings obligated $269M in federal contracts in FY2026 to date. Fresenius Medical Care Holdings received 6 awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $44.8M. Obligations fell 57.7% year over year. Fiscal-year history shows obligations of $275M in FY21, $289M in FY22, $350M in FY23, $0 in FY24, and $635M in FY25. The current-year totals are partial because FY2026 is still in progress, and the presented figures are contract obligations except where table notes specify award values or total contract values. The year-over-year decline reflects the comparison to the prior fiscal period and does not by itself explain why obligations changed. Contractors and analysts assessing Fresenius Medical Care Holdings should note the concentrated award count and relatively large average award size, and should factor in that FY2026 totals are not final.
